Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 9

“Sanjaya said: Having spoken thus to Hrishikesha, Gudakesha, the scorcher of foes, said to Govinda, I shall not fight — and fell silent.”

Three grand names for Krishna and one for Arjuna in a single line, then a flat refusal and silence. Sanjaya lets the weight of the titles collide with the smallness of four words.
